settlementTokenExample.note: Tempo has NO native gas token: this same TIP-20 both funds the escrow and pays the fee that releases it.

proving.requires: SP1 toolchain and ~6.2 GB of Groth16 artifacts in ~/.sp1

settlementCostMeasured.note: fee = gasUsed * effectiveGasPrice / 1e12, derived from real receipts

knownLimits: THERE IS NO EVM-GUEST VERIFIER DEPLOYED ON TEMPO. An EVM deal binding — what the Partner Kit's evmDealBinding produces — cannot be settled on this chain today. Use arc-testnet-evm for EVM re-execution.

A TIP-20 can be paused or policy-gated by its issuer. A pause blocks a payout a valid proof authorised AND blocks refundAfterDeadline, so a third party can close both exits. Disclosed and tested, not mitigated.

Tempo prices state, not compute: a cold SSTORE is ~11.5x and a deployed byte ~12.8x Ethereum's, while BN254 pairing is identical to the gas unit. Any cost sentence about this chain must be about state.
The buyer names the verifier — see arc-testnet-evm.json.
howMeasured: verifier codehash and vkey read from the chain with eth_getCode/eth_call; the codehash agreed with the record written by the deploy run.
